display_name: Florence VR: Climb Cathedral Bell Tower
display_long_description:
Take a VR journey up Florence’s renowned bell tower, where each step brings history to life. Start your ascent up the narrow, stone stairways, taking in glimpses of Florence through small windows that open up to red rooftops and the Tuscan hills. Each level offers its own moment to pause, catch your breath, and appreciate the iconic structure from within.

As you climb higher, feel the air and sunlight changing, creating a unique atmosphere that shifts with every step. At the summit, gaze out over Florence’s red-tiled roofs, the grand dome of the Florence Cathedral, and the rolling countryside in the distance. Yet it’s not just the view that makes this experience unforgettable—it’s the tower itself, an architectural marvel that feels alive as you make your way up and back down.

The VR experience captures every detail of the climb, blending realistic sounds of distant bells, footsteps, and Florence’s ambient sounds, all adding to a feeling of true immersion. Whether for a relaxing escape or a unique way to see Florence, this journey invites you to explore the tower, one stone step at a time.
